name: pump-before-valuation
description: Build some scars with chop, then pump price 30%+ with buys and compare SOL-denominated metrics to a USD mark at the inflated price.
findings: Cursor price moved 926.1%. Paired quote lifetime: 0.218790 SOL -> 0.220790 SOL (unchanged by the pump itself; buys only add pending quote).

Indicative USD mark of scar inventory at 150 USD/SOL: 64.57 -> 68.93 USD. The USD mark rises with the marked price while the SOL-denominated paired counter and current quote inventory do not. UI must show the SOL counters prominently and label USD marks as indicative.
Current scar quote inventory: 0.170535 SOL -> 0.439579 SOL (buys consume scar base and deposit quote; current inventory changes with swaps).
